title: THE FREQUENCY BENEATH · The book, returned
venue: private · after a paperback found in the library's return cart · Box 26
logline: The paperback on the library's returns cart, on top of a road atlas, its card stamped, and the page's last trace: the steady band drawn along the cart's shelf edge like a level, unbroken, going off the page both ways. He returned the book. He didn't return the line.

panels.composition: A library returns cart with a waveform-covered paperback on top of a road atlas, and along the shelf's front edge a thin flat trace drawn like a spirit level's line running off both edges of the page.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a library returns cart with a paperback bearing a waveform cover lying on a road atlas and a thin flat trace drawn along the shelf's front edge running off both sides of the page, no people, no words legible
image.notes: The returns cart (canon: The Reading Room). The line stays after the book goes.
